name: Siphon Spell (Metamagic)
body:
Your spells are more effective against corporeal undead.

Prerequisites: Spell Focus (necromancy).

Benefit: You treat corporeal undead that were once humanoids as humanoids for the purposes of determining which of your spells affect them. In addition, you may affect any corporeal undead creature with mind-affecting spells, regardless of its Intelligence score. A necrotic spell uses up a spell slot one level higher than the spell’s actual level.
